newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy Nov industrial turnover down 8.4 pct yr-yr.
newsitem.headline: Italy Nov industrial turnover down 8.4 pct yr-yr.

text.p: Italian industrial turnover fell 8.4 percent in November, while orders fell 10.3 percent, national statistics institute ISTAT said.
Year on year change -8.4 pct +1.2 pct +14.6 pct
Year on year change -10.3 pct -2.2 pct +10.6 pct

Note: Istat said the fall in turnover was especially marked in the transport sector (-18.1 percent), metal (-17.6 percent), leather goods (-14.8 percent) and publishing (-11.9 percent). Rubber and plastics were down 9.2 percent and textiles were down 7.9 percent. Mining was up 10.2 percent and the oil sector was up 3.4 percent.
For orders, the largest drops were in leather goods (-22.2 percent), metals (-15.6 percent), transport (-12.2 percent), and textiles (-10.8 percent). Rome newsroom +396-678-2501
